title: Three Mondays and One Short Torch
subtitle: 应急救援 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 应急救援（人与自然·灾害防范·救援与急救）
meta: 主题语境：应急救援（人与自然·灾害防范·救援与急救）　|　核心词汇：kit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1998 the rescuer ① packed the kit that no volunteer in the shelter would have recorded, and he said the packing was the whole of the Monday. The ② kit, meaning the pack itself and not the torch, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kit, he said, is the only thing in a shelter that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kit in that shelter had the same short torch beside it, and the ④ kit at the far shelf, meaning the bandage they kept for the children to reach and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the rescuer said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kit was the whole of the matter, meaning the system and not the pack. The ⑥ kit, meaning the system and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kit, he said, is either something you pack or the only word that means both a pack and a system. He said the system is the part they remember.

By 2003 the ⑦ kit had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short torch. The ⑧ kit of the whole thing, the rescuer wrote in April, was one shelter and three Mondays of recording; kit, he said, is either the bandage at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kit I remember is the pack recorded in the log, which closed in 2005 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shelter. A ⑩ kit, my mother said in 2007, is the only pack that improves by being recorded; every kit, she said, is a system that has agreed to look like a pack. She said the system was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 成套工具；应急包（指安置点里每一套旁边的那一套）
B. n. 成套工具；应急包（指那套应急包本身，与手电相对）
C. 固定搭配：pack the kit 收拾这套应急包
D. n. 成套工具；应急包（指留给孩子们够得到的那一卷那一套）
E. n. 备灾之事（抽象总称，指一处安置点的应急包之事）
F. n. 成套工具；应急包（指登记簿里写到、被登记的的那一套）
G. n. 条理、体系（指一件事里人人都理却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 条理（抽象总称，指人人都理却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: packed the kit that no volunteer in the shelter would have recorded
The kit, meaning the pack itself and not the torch
the kit at the far shelf
the kit was the whole of the matter
the kit had become a line in a log
The kit of the whole thing
A kit, my mother said in 2007

answers.why: pack the kit 意为“收拾这套应急包”，1998 年那位救援员把安置点里没有一位志愿者肯登记的一套应急包做了一遍。
kit 意为“成套工具；应急包”，指那套应急包本身而不是手电，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被登记。
kit 意为“成套工具；应急包”，指安置点里每一套旁边的那一套，每一套旁边都有同一支小小的手电。
kit 意为“成套工具；应急包”，指最远那排货架留给孩子们够得到的那一卷那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kit 意为“条理、体系”，指一件事里人人都理却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份条理就是那件事的全部。
kit 意为“条理”，指人人都理却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套应急包，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kit 意为“成套工具；应急包”，指登记簿里写到、被登记的的那一套，到 2003 年这一套成了登记簿里的一行。
kit 意为“备灾之事”，救援员四月写道，整件事的应急包之事是一处安置点和三个星期一的登记。
kit 意为“成套工具；应急包”，我记得的是登记簿里登记过的那一套，2005 年配齐了，至今仍被说成安置点里最安静的一套。
kit 为抽象总称，母亲 2007 年说，应急包是唯一会因为被好好登记而变得更好的应急包。
